title: Redact TOML parse errors for secret-bearing lichend config
description: Security review finding in rust/lichen-gateway/src/config.rs: ConfigError::Parse retains and displays toml::de::Error, whose diagnostic may include source excerpts containing psk_hex/master_salt_hex/id_context_hex. Returning/logging a malformed secret-bearing config can therefore disclose credentials despite Config Debug redaction. Convert parser failures to a source-free redacted error and add a regression test that no configured secret appears in Display or Debug.
